description: This Java source file defines a final class DeleteFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl that provides a builder pattern implementation for creating responses and events related to deleting features in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract builder class and includes nested immutable factory classes for generating response and event objects.
